# netactuate_nke_storage_availability (Data Source)

Lists persistent storage availability at eligible NKE locations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_nke_storage_availability" "example" {
  location_id = 123
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `location_id` (Number) Filter by location ID. Omit to list all eligible locations.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source identifier.
- `locations` (List of Object) Each entry contains `location_id` (Number) and `storage_available` (Boolean).
